scope: Executable temporal evaluation protocol; contains no performance results and performed no model training

ASPH.primary_source: NCD-RisC Lancet 2021 full-precision country-level hypertension dataset

MTC.primary_source: NCD-RisC Nature 2020 age-standardized country cholesterol dataset

old_protocol_semantics.origin_definition: The forecast origin is the final observed year included in the expanding training history.
old_protocol_semantics.training_rule: Use every observation from the series start through origin_year, inclusive.
old_protocol_semantics.horizon_implementation: Statistical models forecast steps 1, 2, and 5 from an origin; ML and neural models construct separate direct-horizon labels at s+h.
old_protocol_semantics.count_explanation: One target is recorded per valid origin. Counts are determined by target-year availability through 2023: T-H-h+1, not by successful model fits.

supervised_sample_rules.H_definition: raw observations available through the forecast origin
supervised_sample_rules.candidate_eligibility: A representation/lookback candidate with fewer than 12 supervised rows is explicitly infeasible for that origin; the threshold must not be lowered.

selected_initial_history_rule.rule: Begin evaluation after 21 observed annual values are available for each target.
selection_basis: chosen before viewing any reconstructed-data model performance
preserves 12 supervised rows for the most demanding already-frozen neural configurations
retains more ASPH folds than 22- or 25-year alternatives
uses the same history-count rule rather than identical calendar years
selected_initial_history_rule.H25_rejection: H=25 would leave ASPH h=5 with only one forecast; retain H=21 and resolve short-series feasibility with an a-priori fixed L=3 instead.

ASPH.training_window_rule: Expanding window from the target's official first year through origin_year, inclusive.

MTC.training_window_rule: Expanding window from the target's official first year through origin_year, inclusive.

model_freeze.omitted_legacy_lookback_reason: Omitted from the Round-2 rerun to avoid unnecessary short-series complexity and multiplicity; they cannot replace or select the L=3 primary result.
model_freeze.neural_outer_fit: Use frozen epoch budgets, every eligible supervised row, validation_n=0, and no early stopping.
model_freeze.round2_protocol_adaptation: Disable the old nested performance-based lookback selector and fit all primary ML/neural direct-horizon models with L=3 fixed before model execution.
model_freeze.runtime_failure_policy: Retain and report numerical or library fit failures; structural executability is not a guarantee that every fit converges.

recent_sensitivity.terminology: Do not use recent regime, regime-aware, or equivalent claims/titles.
recent_sensitivity.reason: ASPH h1 has only nine primary target years; a final-eight-year window would nearly duplicate the primary evaluation and would not be an independent temporal-regime assessment.

metrics_policy.reporting_completeness_rule: Every Methods-listed metric must appear in a main table or a specifically cited appendix table.

1.holm_adjustment: apply only across valid formal DM comparisons; exclude undefined tests
1.empirical_interval_coverage: descriptive only; report valid interval n and missing/invalid intervals

timing_instrumentation.per_fit_elapsed_wall_clock: Record selection, feature construction, fit, forecast, interval, and total elapsed seconds for every target/model/horizon/origin/seed fit.
timing_instrumentation.cumulative_fit_time: Sum per-fit fit_seconds separately; never label this as experiment duration.
timing_instrumentation.overall_experiment_wall_clock: Measure once around the complete orchestrated run, including worker scheduling and reporting.
timing_instrumentation.parallel_worker_count: Record configured and observed workers for each run stage.
timing_instrumentation.reporting_rule: Future results must label cumulative compute time and elapsed experiment wall-clock time as different quantities.

prohibitions: No model training or forecasting in Phase 2A.1
No interpolation, extrapolation, imputation, smoothing, or synthetic extension of the source series
No future observation in any fold
No evaluation-period performance for split, representation, lookback, hyperparameter, or epoch selection
No nested performance-based lookback selection in the Round-2 primary analysis
No recent-period or regime model-selection analysis
No manuscript, frozen first-round result, Git tag, or release modification
